name: io.github.mindstone/mcp-server-google-workspace
title: Google Workspace
description: Google Workspace MCP server for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Contacts, and more

environmentVariables.name: ACCOUNTS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to accounts.json written by the MCP host

environmentVariables.name: CREDENTIALS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Directory containing per-account Google OAuth token files

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_GOOGLE_TASKS_FORMS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register Google Tasks and Forms tools

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Outbound Google API request timeout in milliseconds (max 300000 = 5 min)

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_DISABLE_REFRESH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable background OAuth token refresh (tokens are only read, never refreshed)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Directory attachments and downloaded files are constrained to (defaults to a temp dir; reads/writes outside it are refused)

environmentVariables.name: WORKSPACE_BASE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Legacy fallback for MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH; prefer MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH

environmentVariables.name: GAUTH_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Legacy fallback path to gauth.json OAuth client config; host-orchestrated setups use GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET instead
